title: Ootle Steam Kit
summary: Steam-linked Ootle integration kit with wallet, trade, games and prediction modules. The October 29 public guide loaded; Games, Trade and Predict were disabled before Steam sign-in. The guide says the site currently watches deliveries and settles holds itself, while template-enforced trade escrow is a future destination. Source supports optional wallet-daemon integration and a local ledger mode. Do not interpret the guide or its recording as a completed Steam trade or independently enforced settlement. MIT source reviewed; no Steam login, wallet connection, payment or gameplay was exercised.
cardSummary: Explore Steam-linked wallet, trading and game modules with private testnet payments and an operator-managed settlement flow.
creator: iGaming

recording.credit: Docs walkthrough — Public settlement guide; no Steam login, trade or payment.
